title: Machine learning selects senescence genes shared by atherosclerosis and diabetic foot
summary: From 72 senescence-related genes differentially expressed in both diseases, LASSO, random forest and SVM-RFE consensus selected CALCOCO1, CCND2 and FUCA1. A nomogram using them reached AUC 0.96 for diabetic foot ulcer and 0.90 for atherosclerosis in the public datasets. An independent clinical cohort of 22 patients (11 ulcer, 11 non-diabetic controls) showed senescent cell accumulation and dysregulated expression, and metformin attenuated induced fibroblast senescence in vitro. The validation cohort is very small and the AUCs come from training data.
ai_technology: LASSO, random forest and SVM-RFE feature selection on transcriptomic data

evidence.tested: Single-cell data, a 22-patient tissue cohort and in vitro fibroblast experiments.
evidence.unknown: Diagnostic validity in larger cohorts and causal roles of the genes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning feature selection prioritized the three core genes.
